title: Stark Agent Definition v2
description: One file per agent under .deep_agents/config/agents/<key>.json. Built-in keys are validated overrides with compiled caps; any other key is a full custom definition. Custom agents are closed-world: tools is required (use [] for none); missing skills/mcp means none. Custom Code Mode is opt-in hybrid and requires the execute tool.

version.description: v1 files are read and migrated on read; every write is v2.

key.description: Optional in-file copy of the filename key. The filename wins.

tier.description: Model matrix tier: workspace, specialist, or orchestrator. Empty inherits the built-in/custom default.

provider.description: Provider id present in providers.json. Null inherits the active provider.

model.description: Model key, id, or alias for the selected provider. Null inherits the tier matrix.

access.description: Custom agents: root access. write is capped to a worktree when spawned. Built-ins: may narrow, never widen, their compiled cap.

profile.description: coding uses the Developer composer; general uses the generic composer. Built-ins keep their compiled profile.

persona.description: Appended after harness/safety instructions. Code-enforced guards are never removed by a persona.

system_prompt.description: Legacy v1 persona. Do not combine with prompt.persona.

tools.description: Built-ins: optional subset of the compiled scope contract. Custom agents: the complete closed tool list; required for new custom agents (use [] for none).

skills.description: Skill names discovered under workspace or harness .agents/skills and .deep_agents/skills. Built-ins: null/omitted means all. Custom: omitted means none. Save/preview accepts workspace_path to validate project-local skills; without it unknown names are warnings.

mcp.description: Configured MCP server names. Built-ins: null/omitted means all. Custom: omitted means none.

aliases.description: Compatibility names. Never listed as agents. Must not shadow any key or alias. Built-in aliases are fixed and ignore this field.

delegatable.description: May be selected as a delegate target.

can_delegate.description: May call delegate/delegation_status. Built-ins are capped.

can_spawn.description: May use spawn_agent and the durable agent tree. Built-ins are capped.

routing.description: Custom-agent auto-routing. Applied only when no explicit agent/chat agentKey exists and the workspace kind is generic. A unique match wins; multiple matches fall back to the built-in heuristic with a warning. Both lists non-empty means both must match.

paths.description: Glob patterns over the normalised absolute workspace path.

code_mode.description: Custom agents support off or hybrid. hybrid requires the execute tool. only and full_codemode are built-in Developer features.

full_codemode.description: Built-in Developer only. Custom agents cannot enable it; use hybrid Code Mode for the base surface.
